title: 📚 Skills
intro: Reusable playbooks your agents can follow — plain SKILL.md files in the common open format. Install a pack from a URL, or an agent can save one itself after doing something worth repeating.

install.title: 🔗 Install from a link
install.body: A GitHub repo or folder URL, a .zip, or a raw SKILL.md link. New skills are scanned for anything sketchy before they can be turned on.
install.flagged: 🔍 Installed — some skills need a look before they can be enabled

empty: No skills yet — install one above.

discover.title: 🔭 Discover skills
discover.body: Search thousands of open-source skills from <a1>skills.sh</a1> and <a2>SkillsMP</a2>. Your agents can search here too when they're missing a know-how.
discover.placeholder: pdf forms, notion, excel charts, flight deals…
